title: NC surface grinder
subtitle: Dener TGH-B 450 · 17.7 × 35.4″ table · 15.7 × 31.5″ magnetic chuck · Mitsubishi NC feeds in 0.00004″ steps
about_title: A precision NC surface grinder from Dener's machine-tool plant
about_text: The TGH-B 450 grinds flat, parallel and square faces on dies, moulds, plates and machine parts: a 17.7 × 35.4″ (450 × 900 mm) table on scraped, Turcite-B coated V and flat guideways, driven hydraulically at 16 – 82 ft/min, a Ø13.8″ (350 mm) wheel on a direct-drive spindle with 21.7″ (550 mm) under the wheel centre, and AC servo motors on ballscrews for the cross and vertical axes under a Mitsubishi NC with a 10″ touchscreen — the operator sets the stock to remove and the machine down-feeds in 0.00004″ (0.001 mm) steps and cross-feeds by itself.

Dener Makina has built machinery in Kayseri since 1974, and since 2016 CNC machine tools in the Taksan plant it took over. NovoTech sells, installs and supports the grinder in Canada from Mississauga, Ontario, Canada, with a CSA-approved panel and a 1-year warranty.
